summaries.Romania: Romania faced three drone incursions in 48 hours with military successfully intercepting all three, triggering diplomatic protests and raising NATO Article 4 discussions. Meanwhile, the country grapples with fuel price spikes, healthcare worker strikes, and critical EU funding deadlines for recovery plans.
summaries.Healthcare: Healthcare innovation continues with AI-driven care management expansion, rare disease drug approvals, and digital health platforms gaining traction, while systemic challenges around ACA marketplace stability and provider burnout persist.
summaries.Tech: Apple prepares privacy-focused smart glasses for WWDC 2027 reveal, while broader industry moves include Nvidia-Microsoft open AI security alliance, vertical video dominance, and ongoing concerns about AI safety and border device security.

items.title: Varta își cere insolvența după ce Apple, principalul său client, a decis să-și procure din China bateriile
items.snippet: Oficialii Varta spun că nu există pericolul de a nu-și îndeplini obligațiile de plată, că producția va continua, în timp ce salariile vor fi și ele plătite, scrie Euronews. Compania-mamă a renumitei mărci de baterii Varta a anunțat că a solicitat Tribunalului Local din Stuttgart deschiderea procedur
items.line: Apple's pivot away from Varta batteries to Chinese suppliers forces the German company into insolvency proceedings, signaling major supply chain restructuring in tech manufacturing.

items.title: A treia dronă doborâtă de piloții români de F-16. Nicușor Dan anunță protest diplomatic față Rusia: „Este inadmisibil și intolerabil”
items.snippet: O nouă dronă a fost doborâtă duminică dimineață, la ora 10:13, de un avion F-16 al Forțelor Aeriene Române, deasupra apelor teritoriale ale României, în zona Sulina–Chilia, a anunțat președintele Nicușor Dan. items.line: Romania successfully intercepted its third Russian drone in as many days over territorial waters, prompting formal diplomatic protest and NATO coordination discussions.

items.snippet:

items.title: STAT+: Argenx to buy Forte Biosciences for $2.2B
items.snippet: Argenx plans to buy Forte Biosciences for $2.2 billion, expanding its pipeline of drugs that could treat multiple autoimmune diseases.
items.line: Argenx acquires Forte Biosciences for $2.2B to expand its autoimmune disease drug pipeline, signaling continued consolidation in immunology therapeutics.

items.title: OpenAI makes Health in ChatGPT widely available, moving deeper into consumer health
items.snippet: OpenAI on Thursday made its Health in ChatGPT feature broadly available, enabling U.S. users to connect its artificial intelligence chatbot with medical records and wellness apps.
items.line: OpenAI expands Health in ChatGPT to all U.S. users, enabling direct integration with medical records and wellness apps, advancing AI's clinical adoption.

items.title: Indicele de masă corporală este un instrument depășit. Noul scor care ar putea schimba tratamentul problemelor cu greutatea
items.snippet: Două persoane cu același indice de masă corporală pot avea riscuri foarte diferite de diabet, boli cardiovasculare sau cancer. Un nou instrument dezvoltat de cercetători britanici și germani ar putea estima mai precis cine are nevoie de tratament pentru obezitate înainte de apariția complicațiilor.
items.line: British and German researchers develop new obesity assessment tool superior to BMI, potentially transforming treatment prioritization for weight-related diseases.

items.title: Teladoc Health unveils new virtual care model for employers, health plans that ties payment to results
items.snippet: Teladoc Health unveiled a new virtual care model for employers and health plans designed to offer a more coordinated, personalized approach for members, while tying payment to clinical and financial outcomes.
items.line: Teladoc Health unveils outcomes-based virtual care model tying employer/plan payments to clinical results, reshaping telehealth reimbursement economics.

items.title: Claude Cowork escaped sandbox on Mac, gain full access to all files
items.snippet:
Security researchers demonstrated that Claude Cowork could escape the sandbox intended to control the access it gets to your Mac. The exploit, dubbed ShareRoot, could allow an attacker to read and write files stored anywhere on your Mac, as well as access login credentials for online services.
Aroun
items.line: Claude Cowork AI escape exploits (ShareRoot) demonstrate critical sandbox vulnerabilities allowing full Mac file system and credential access, highlighting AI safety risks.
